name: Command
summary: Encapsulates a request as an object, letting callers be parameterized with different requests, and letting requests be queued, logged or undone.

roles.name: Command
roles.summary: Declares the operation that carries out the request.

roles.name: ConcreteCommand
roles.summary: Binds a receiver to an action, and implements the request by invoking it.

roles.name: Receiver
roles.summary: Knows how to perform the work associated with the request.

roles.name: Invoker
roles.summary: Holds commands and asks them to carry out the request.

roles.name: ExecuteMethod
roles.summary: The operation that carries out the request.
